action_items: No API-bearing criteria in this matrix (pure CSS/typography fix on static portfolio) - no backend pytest lane required.

checks.criterion: Nama Hero kembali besar di desktop/laptop
checks.name: hero-name-large-desktop
checks.evidence: At 1280x800 viewport, hero-name computed font-size measured >=110px (target met, was 94.72px before fix), full name text visible, no overlap with profile-image-placeholder bounding box, no horizontal document overflow, greeting/headline/intro/badges all visible.

checks.criterion: Nama Hero kembali besar di mobile
checks.name: hero-name-large-mobile
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, hero-name computed font-size measured >=67px (target met, was 58.5px before fix), full name text present and not clipped (no overflow:hidden with scrollHeight>clientHeight), no horizontal document overflow, greeting/headline/badges visible.

checks.name: hero-portfolio-identity
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed after name-size fix: greeting 'Halo, saya', full name, headline, intro, CTA button, profile photo placeholder, AVAILABLE FOR PKL and OPEN TO NEW IDEAS badges all visible with no bounding-box overlap between the two badges. Two benign WebSocket console errors (HMR dev-server related, unrelated to hero) observed but did not fail the check.

checks.criterion: Regresi komposisi Hero (profile photo quality re-check)
checks.name: hero-profile-photo-quality
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: profile photo loaded (complete && naturalWidth>0), portrait crop confirmed, PKL badge does not intersect face zone - confirms no new overlap introduced by larger hero name.
